snippet.title: Moonsigil Atlas - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The deckbuilding roguelike with no energy – play cards using physical space! Slot cards together, manipulate the shape of your cards, and create overpowered combos to break the game!

🔗 Officially release on May 28th! Wishlist it & Play the demo now ➡ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3284290/Moonsigil_Atlas/
